Begin from Chapter 9 of the Main Story?

If you have already completed Chapter 8 of the Main Story with a different character, you can start the game from Main Task "Alter Realm Mission Report".

Note: With the exception of certain items, you will not receive rewards for any skipped tasks. After skipping, you will start at a higher level.

This option is currently unavailable.
It will become available after completing
the PSO2:NGS prologue.
